messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm adding a simple experiment quickstart to the console docs. Want to make sure we don't ship confusing defaults for routing/guards.

mira: awesome, can you sketch the flow? :eyes:

alex: Plan: create experiment -> add variants -> set traffic rules -> add guardrails (quota, per-user holdout, health checks) -> launch. Need API contract for the routing rule UI.

jon: two quick asks: 1) default sampling should be low (1-5%) for first rollout, 2) we should auto-create telemetry hooks for any metric selected so users get early regression alerts.

mira: agree on low sample. Also add an option to "auto-fail" if latency regresses > X ms for Y minutes. Otherwise teams keep launching broken models.

sara: UX note — users get confused by "traffic weight" vs "exposure". Can we show both: percent traffic and estimated unique users/day?

alex: good call. We can surface estimated uniques using recent traffic per route. Adds transparency.

jon: for the routing rule API I propose a compact object like:

```
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "variants": [
    {"id": "v1", "weight": 90},
    {"id": "v2", "weight": 10}
  ],
  "guards": {
    "min_sample_pct": 1,
    "per_user_holdout": 0.02,
    "latency_fail_ms": 200,
    "latency_window_minutes": 10
  }
}
```

mira: that looks sane. A couple of comments: use `min_sample_pct` as a floor only — allow transient bumps for routing during bursts. Also we need to persist the rollout history for audit.

alex: noted. Also want to add an "automatic rollback" toggle that executes if any safety guard trips. Default off.

eng-bot: deploy-bot noticed: "experiment-service" staging deployed at 1793456802 :package:

jon: telemetry events we should emit on start/stop/rollout/guard_trip: `experiment.started`, `experiment.traffic_split`, `experiment.guard_triggered`, `experiment.rolled_back`. Add associated tags: experiment_id, variant_id, rule_id, metric_name.

sara: for dashboarding, can we emit percentile latencies (p50/p95) and token-cost delta per-variant? Ops needs cost visibility.

mira: yes. Also a continuous quality metric: compare top-1 prompt success rate or custom eval set if provided.

alex: UX Q: onboarding default shows two variants (control + candidate) and prefilled weight 95/5. Is that too aggressive?

jon: 95/5 is fine if we make the sample small. I'd prefer 98/2 for low-risk features. But main thing is to show recommended sample and a big warning if >10% without a canary.

mira: add a lightweight modal that warns: "High exposure: verify SLA and run smoke checks" with links to test-run and rollback docs.

alex: how should we expose per-route guard rules vs global org defaults? My thought: org defaults apply unless overridden at experiment level. Show inheritance in UI.

sara: +1. Also add a way to pin a default quantization profile per variant to estimate cost.

jon: API concern: the routing decision must be deterministic per-user across requests (consistent hashing) so that experiments are sticky. Document that in SDKs.

mira: and add an emergency stop API endpoint for SRE that can short-circuit all experiments for a customer or route.

alex: good. I'll draft the quickstart and the JSON schema and push a PR. Will include example telemetry query for p95 diff and a prebuilt dashboard.

eng-bot: alex opened PR #4127: "console: experiment quickstart + guardrails" at 1793456920 :github: 

alex: ping @mira for UX review when the PR is up. I'll also add the modal content and the per-route estimate.

mira: will review today. small nit: call the rollback toggle `auto_pause_on_guard` to emphasize it's non-decisive.

jon: one last thought — add a short TTL for old experiments to auto-archive after 90 days if no activity. Keeps console tidy.

sara: love that. OK to merge once UX + telemetry hooks are wired. :+1:

alex: thanks all — merging after addresses. If anyone thinks defaults are still risky we can bump the sample floor to 0.5% instead of 1%.

mira: fine with 0.5% as an initial floor.

alex: last_message: pushing changes now, will post a follow-up with the PR link and dashboard ids.
thread_summary: Discussion about UX and API defaults for experiment quickstart: routing rule schema, guardrails (sample floor, latency fail), telemetry events, rollback behavior, and dashboard needs.
